$comment: 2D static-map geometry. Frames from Figma 1D6lW84rl4yYR8VQwV10Pp (Tablet 34:709 map 34:771 = 736:666, Phone 56:1378 map 56:1398 = 1:1). The image is own render /img/island-<theme>.webp (npm run island, 736:666; the phone map shows its centre square, object-fit: cover). Hotspots are % of the map box (left/top/width/height) = projection of each stop's buildings on that render (src/scene/framing.ts, checked by framing.spec.ts); Monitoring = the central plaza. Figma reference hotspots (exported 2026-10-22) were placed on the concept crop and replaced 2026-10-23 (T10).
notes: Hotspot '30-sec summary' intentionally omitted: summary is reached via deep-link #summary and links in Contact/Monitoring (decision R3).
Pin/Compact (36px circle, chapter colour, number) is rendered by the frontend on top of each hotspot centre; min target 44×44 (WCAG 2.5.8).
Accessible name of a hotspot = '<index> <label>' (e.g. '02 ProSpace · Latest role'); Monitoring has no index.
Tablet frame = 768×1024 viewport with fixed BottomBar compact (104px); phone = 390×844 viewport with fixed 2D bar 72px (6 stops + chapter names 12px).
